items.title: Agencies seek comment on proposed third-party risk management guidance and issue statement on community bank engagement with core service providers
items.summary: Agencies seek comment on proposed third-party risk management guidance and issue statement on community bank engagement with core service providers
items.why: Proposed interagency guidance sets new regulatory expectations for bank third-party risk management.

items.title: Being a renter, Jenny missed out on solar boon but that is about to change
items.summary: Australia readies to lift a ban on plug-in solar, unlocking access to the technology for millions of apartment dwellers and renters for the first time.
items.why: Lifting a regulatory ban on plug-in solar represents a significant policy change opening access for renters.

items.title: London tourist tax on accommodation will be capped at 5pc, mayor says
items.summary: Legislation unveiled by the government this week will allow local authorities to charge a flat fee or percentage of an overnight stay for domestic and international guests in London accommodations.
items.why: New legislation unveiled introducing a tourist tax cap in London.

items.title: Pensioners to shoulder huge portion of private health insurance 'cash grab'
items.summary: Pensioners will be hit hard by the federal government's controversial private health insurance rebate changes, with new analysis revealing that about half of the $3 billion in forecast savings will be clawed back from those on lower incomes.
items.why: New analysis reveals government health rebate changes disproportionately hit low-income pensioners.

items.title: Community 'blindsided' by legislation change fears becoming ghost town
items.summary: The state government introduces legislation to repeal a requirement for a coal mine to house its workforce in a nearby town.
items.why: Government introduced legislation repealing a coal mine's local workforce housing requirement.

items.title: US Fed hikes interest rates to curb inflation in move likely to rile Trump
items.summary: The US economy has been dealing with years of higher-than-target inflation, and prices have surged in the wake of Mr Trump's war on Iran, his signature tariff policies and the ongoing AI boom.
items.why: Major US Federal Reserve monetary policy decision to hike interest rates.

items.title: Live: US policymakers expect Fed to raise rates again this year
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates by 25 basis points and policymakers expect one more hike before the end of the year.
items.why: Fed interest rate hike and signal of further tightening is a major central bank policy decision.

items.title: Smart glasses ban looms as Labor sets out new AI rules
items.summary: Smart glasses could be prohibited in Commonwealth workplaces as the government consults on new rules for Australia's growing AI sector.
items.why: Government consulting on new AI sector rules and potential workplace smart glasses prohibition.
